subject: Vendor portal activation & evidence custody - kickoff
messages:
From: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@novumcloud.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: security@novumcloud.com
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor portal provisioning & evidence handoff request

Hi Karthik / Jordan,

Thanks for taking this — NovumCloud is ready to start the security portal onboarding for our planned integration. We need to provision a NovumCloud profile in Vendr (preferred) and OneTrust as a fallback. Primary asks: share the onboarding checklist, define evidence custody (what you need uploaded vs. pointers to public attestations), and confirm who on your side will own the profile updates going forward.

Quick context: we completed a SOC 2 Type II in Q4 2026 (summary attached) and have a partially filled SIG spreadsheet. We anticipate the CAIQ mapping will be a follow-up. Can you also confirm whether Redwood accepts presigned S3 uploads or prefers portal uploads?

Attached: NovumCloud-SOC2-2026-summary.pdf, SIG-Mapping- starter.xlsx

Availability: we can do a 30-minute kickoff next week (Mon/Tue afternoon PT). Please send a calendar invite with dial-in.

Best,
Suresh Patel
Sr. Security Program Manager
NovumCloud

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@novumcloud.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2027 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning & evidence handoff request

Hi Suresh — thanks for the packet and context. Looping in Marissa (security intake + portal onboarding) to run the evidence handoff and profile ownership.

High-level answer to your questions:
- We prefer direct portal uploads to Vendr for the canonical record; presigned S3 is accepted for large archives but we ask that you also provide a manifest (CSV) and a CAIQ mapping doc for indexing.
- For initial onboarding Redwood will: create the Vendr record, seed the CAIQ/SIG fields from your sheet, and request missing artifacts. After the initial handoff, Marissa will be the profile steward for coordination; Jordan will be the escalation contact for SLA/timeout issues.

Action items: please confirm the primary portal admin (name + email) we should invite. Also pick a 30-minute slot next Tue (Sep 14) between 1:00–3:30pm PT and we'll send an invite.

I'll attach a short checklist in the follow-up (artifact list + manifest template).

Thanks,
Karthik
Head of Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference

From: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@novumcloud.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com, security@novumcloud.com
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:09:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor portal provisioning & evidence handoff request

Karthik / Marissa,

Confirmed — invite attached for Tue Sep 14 1:30pm PT. Primary portal admin will be Priya Menon <priya.menon@novumcloud.com>. She will handle uploads and follow-ups.

Couple of notes before the call:
- One of our controls documentation files is large (~120MB). If Vendr portal upload max is <100MB we will use presigned S3 and provide the manifest + hash list.
- We would like a one-time mapping session during onboarding to review which SOC 2 evidence maps to SIG/CAIQ controls — that will speed future refreshes.

Thanks,
Suresh

--- Forwarded attachment list ---
NovumCloud-SOC2-2026-summary.pdf (attached)
SIG-Mapping- starter.xlsx (attached)

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Suresh Patel <suresh.patel@novumcloud.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Vendor portal provisioning & evidence handoff request

Thanks Suresh — see quick preflight and mutual action plan below (so we have the same expectations before tomorrow's call).

Preflight checklist (what we need to create the Vendr profile and accept evidence):
- Primary portal admin (email) for invites: Priya Menon <priya.menon@novumcloud.com> (confirmed)
- Signed SOC 2 summary (we have the PDF) and control-owner contact matrix (please add if available)
- SIG worksheet (we'll use your starter sheet as the seed)
- Preferred upload method: portal upload for files <100MB, presigned S3 for larger items + manifest.csv with SHA256 hashes
- Proof-of-possession items (e.g., signed policy PDFs) — please label filenames as \"controlID_description_year.pdf\"

Mutual action plan (short):
1) Marissa creates Vendr profile and invites Priya (within 4 business hours of this message).
2) Priya uploads SOC2 summary + SIG starter. If using S3, attach manifest to the Vendr ticket.
3) We run a 30-minute CAIQ mapping session (today's call) and capture gaps and owner assignments.
4) Post-call: Marissa will open a portal ticket with a prioritized artifact list and target dates for the remaining items.

Attachments I'll send after the call: manifest template (CSV), naming conventions doc, and a short onboarding timeline.

If that looks good I'll start the profile setup now and send the Vendr invite to Priya.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Security Operations
Redwood Inference
